## Welcome to KeySnapshots 📷
A place for photographers, customers and creators to learn, get help and share their experience with photo delivery.

**Start with these channels**
• Read the community guidelines in <#1547840737679384576>.
• Find official links and answers in <#1547840741844197497>.
• Introduce yourself in <#1547840744121966612>.
• Ask general product questions in <#1547840751864516738>.
• Share a suggestion in <#1547840748714594485>.

**Need access?**
If you cannot see the community channels, contact the server administrator about Member access. Photographer and Creator Community access require verification. For help with verification, email support@keysnapshots.com; do not post your account email here.

**Keep private information private**
Never post gallery codes, passwords, receipts, payment details or identity documents in Discord. Use official support for account-specific questions. Staff will never ask for your password in Discord.

## KeySnapshots quick links 🔗
**I received photos**
• [Open KeySnapshots / redeem a code](https://keysnapshots.com/en)
• [Help Center](https://keysnapshots.com/en/help-center)
• [Order and download support](https://keysnapshots.com/en/order-support)

**I am a photographer**
• [Open Studio](https://keysnapshots.com/en/studio)
• [Photographer quick start](https://keysnapshots.com/en/help-center/photographer-quick-start)
• [About KeySnapshots for photographers](https://keysnapshots.com/en/for-photographers)

**Creator Community**
• [Learn about the program / apply](https://keysnapshots.com/en/creator-community)
• [Member dashboard](https://keysnapshots.com/en/community)
• [Member support](https://keysnapshots.com/en/community/support)

**Policies**
[Terms of Service](https://keysnapshots.com/en/terms-of-service) · [Privacy Policy](https://keysnapshots.com/en/privacy-policy)

Some account pages require sign-in and the appropriate account access. For private help, email **support@keysnapshots.com**. General questions belong in <#1547840751864516738>; never include private account details in a public post.

## Quick answers
**Do I need an account to open my photos?**
Customers can redeem a code and open their gallery without creating a customer account. Follow the gallery's instructions if a purchase is required.

**My code or gallery is not working. What should I do?**
Check that you entered the code as shown on your card or message, then follow any status shown on the page. If you still need help, use [Order Support](https://keysnapshots.com/en/order-support) or email support@keysnapshots.com. Keep the code out of Discord.

**Where do I get help with a purchase or download?**
Use [Order Support](https://keysnapshots.com/en/order-support). Do not post receipts or payment details here. Download and save your photos while the gallery is available.

**Where do photographers start?**
Open [Studio](https://keysnapshots.com/en/studio) and follow the [Quick Start](https://keysnapshots.com/en/help-center/photographer-quick-start).

**Where can I suggest an improvement?**
Post one idea in <#1547840748714594485>. Explain the problem, your current workaround and the outcome you want.

**Can Discord resolve account or payout decisions?**
Those cases belong in official private support. Discord is for general guidance; your account pages and current product policies remain authoritative.

## Your photographer starting point 📷
**Set up and deliver your first photo moment**
1. Open [Studio](https://keysnapshots.com/en/studio) and complete your account and profile setup.
2. Follow the [Photographer Quick Start](https://keysnapshots.com/en/help-center/photographer-quick-start).
3. Create a digital code or use a valid Photo Key Card code.
4. Add your photos and choose the delivery and pricing options available in Studio.
5. Check the customer experience before sharing the code or link privately with your customer.

**Useful places**
• [Photographer overview](https://keysnapshots.com/en/for-photographers)
• [Help Center](https://keysnapshots.com/en/help-center)
• [Studio billing and payouts](https://keysnapshots.com/en/studio/billing)
• Workflow discussion: <#1547840756415209504>
• General troubleshooting: <#1547840751864516738>

Share only photos you have permission to share. Keep client information and gallery codes out of community posts. Account, billing and payout questions go to support@keysnapshots.com; Studio shows your current account status.

## Creator Community resource library
Use the current resources in your member dashboard when preparing content. These pages require the appropriate member access.

• [Member dashboard](https://keysnapshots.com/en/community)
• [Marketing toolkit and approved resources](https://keysnapshots.com/en/community/resources)
• [Disclosure guidance](https://keysnapshots.com/en/community/ftc-disclosure-obligations)
• [Brand safety and honest promotion](https://keysnapshots.com/en/community/brand-safety-honest-promotion)
• [Code of Conduct](https://keysnapshots.com/en/community/code-of-conduct)
• [Current program terms](https://keysnapshots.com/en/community/program-terms)
• [Private member support](https://keysnapshots.com/en/community/support)

**Before sharing content**
Check the latest approved assets and guidance, describe the product accurately, and follow the disclosure requirements in your program documents. Avoid promises about earnings or outcomes.

Use <#1547840765009330297> for peer discussion. Keep customer information and private performance, commission or payout details in the product's support system. Your dashboard and current program documents control program matters.

## Community guidelines
**Be respectful.** Keep discussions constructive. No harassment, hate, threats or targeted abuse.

**Protect privacy.** Do not share gallery codes, passwords, emails, receipts, payment details, private messages or identity documents.

**Share responsibly.** Post only photos and other content you own or have permission to share. Respect client consent and requests to remove content. Keep content appropriate for the community.

**No scams or spam.** No phishing, impersonation, malware, referral manipulation or repeated unsolicited promotion.

**Use the right channel.** Search before opening a Help Desk post. Keep one issue or idea per post and redact private information from screenshots.

**Use official support for private cases.** Account, purchase and payout matters belong in KeySnapshots support, not public Discord threads. A Discord role does not imply employment, endorsement or guaranteed earnings.

**Need to report a concern?** Contact a server administrator or email support@keysnapshots.com. Do not repost harmful or private material publicly.

[KeySnapshots Terms](https://keysnapshots.com/en/terms-of-service) · [Privacy Policy](https://keysnapshots.com/en/privacy-policy)
Current product policies apply alongside these community guidelines.

## Say hello 👋
What brought you to KeySnapshots? Share the kind of photography you enjoy and one thing you would like to learn or make easier. Share only what you are comfortable making public.

A starting prompt: **What makes handing photos to someone feel memorable?**

Need product help? Use <#1547840751864516738>. Have an idea? Use <#1547840748714594485>. Official links are in <#1547840741844197497>.
